system.description:
The Serpentis power The Heart of Darkness normally takes hours to perform on other vampires and only works at the dark of the moon. Some Setite elders, however, can pull the heart from another vampire's chest with a quick snatch of the hand. This does not destroy the vampire unless the Setite then destroys the stolen heart.

Stealing the heart of an unwilling vampire uses the same Physical Challenge as staking a vampire. A vampire who loses his heart this way takes one unsoakable level of aggravated damage and receives all the benefits and drawbacks of The Heart of Darkness: resisting frenzy becomes easier, and she cannot be staked through the breast, but a stake thrust through the removed heart instantly forces her into torpor, and exposing the heart to fire or sunlight destroys her utterly.
system.source: Clanbook: Followers of Set, Chapter Two
